reconciliation.therapy: Product-specific adult oral phases added, no AF dose-rule transfer, individualized contraindications and alternatives.
reconciliation.distal: Selected CHEST weekly-two-week surveillance is compatible with ESVS first reassessment at one week; no automatic treatment of every distal DVT and no unscheduled surveillance discharge.
reconciliation.intervention: Selected iliofemoral/limb-threat review, not routine thrombolysis or filter.
reconciliation.version_status: No newer final dedicated ESVS/CHEST DVT replacement identified in this review. ESVS2027 under development is not a current edition; NICE May2026 review is not a2026 new guideline.

portugal_context.DGS: Norma030/2011 updated2015-07-10 on lower-limb venous Doppler identified on official DGS site. No claim of a newly verified2026 DVT anticoagulation Norma or national conformity.
portugal_context.INFARMED: Public2019 apixaban assessment identified as historical reimbursement/evaluation material, not current dosing authority. Current EMA SmPCs used for product-reference doses. No hospital-stock inference.
portugal_context.local_circuit: No particular scan service, drug brand, vascular-call coverage or guaranteed transfer time independently verified. Bedside/site checks remain explicit.
